steps.message: I read both files in the request so I could respect the scope boundary: `CouponService.cs` (to migrate) and `AuditLogger.cs` (to leave alone). `Program.cs` already registers `TimeProvider.System`.

I kept the change inside the scope you set: `CouponService.cs` only, `AuditLogger.cs` left for your later pass. `TimeProvider` is already registered in `Program.cs`, so no DI change was needed.

## Migration Summary

**Pattern:** `DateTime.UtcNow` → injected `TimeProvider`
**Scope (you specified):** `ReadyToMigrate/Services/CouponService.cs`

### Files Modified (production)

| File | Call Sites Replaced | Injection Added |
|------|--------------------:|:----------------|
| CouponService.cs | 4 | Yes (constructor) |

`CouponService` now takes `TimeProvider timeProvider` on its constructor, stored as `private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider`, and every `DateTime.UtcNow` reads `_timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime` (Kind stays `Utc`). The intentional `DateTime.Now` in `IsRedeemableToday` was left as-is.

### Remaining (out of scope)

- `AuditLogger.cs` — still calls `DateTime.UtcNow` in `LogAction`. I deliberately left this file completely untouched because you asked to defer it. When you are ready, ask me and I will migrate it the same way.
